program: IGNOU CLIS (Certificate in Library and Information Science)
format: OMR / MCQ, evening session (per IGNOU revised date sheet)

units.name: Block 1: Library Basics & Contexts (role in society, types of libraries, functional units, staff)
Block 2: Library Routines (selection & acquisition, physical processing, accession register, maintenance)
Classification basics + DDC (10 main classes, schedules, standard subdivisions)
Cataloguing basics + AACR-2R (main & added entries, MARC tags)
Filing rules (ALA vs CCC) + shelving & shelf rectification
Categories of information sources (primary / secondary / tertiary)
Types of sources (dictionaries, encyclopedias, yearbooks, bibliographies)
Reference service (ready vs long-range) + awareness services (CAS & SDI) + user orientation
Internet tools & services (networks, search engines, Web 2.0, digital libraries)

notes: Unit weights are estimates from examples/ignou-clis-exam-blueprint.md and known PYQ archetypes. Refine them after downloading real papers with scripts/fetch_materials.py. Course codes follow the date sheet; eGyankosh labels paper 1 as 'BLII-011'.
